1879072550.name: Mobilise
1879072550.desc: You compel your allies to greatly hasten their movement for a brief time.

1879073702.name: Moving Target
1879073702.desc: You can better evade the attacks of your foes for a short period of time.

1879095078.name: Lightning Storm
1879095078.desc: Vicious lightning strikes at the enemy.\n\n<rgb=#ff0091>With Improved Ignition, this skill can cash-out Burning Embers for bonus damage.</rgb>

conditionalEffects.description: \nLightning Storm Critical Hits attract lightning motes to you.
Lightning Skills gain the ability to consume Burning Embers for bonus damage\n\nWhen consuming higher tiers of Burning Embers, this damage is greatly increased.

procEffects.description: DNT - Wild Sigils reduce the active cooldown of Sign of the Wild: Rage

1879096870.name: Scribe Manual: Flute
1879096870.desc: This will scribe a manual to teach others to play the flute. Doing so is much more taxing than training in person and requires a Blank Mentor Manual.

1879097894.name: Web the Earth
1879097894.desc: Your webs can be used to create sticky areas on the ground that slow the movement of any enemy who dares cross them.

1879109286.name: Epic for the Ages
1879109286.desc:
A big heal.

+Healing per attunement.
 
 Requires Healing Attunement.

1879143078.name: Adroit Manoeuvre
1879143078.desc: A strike that lets the Warden attack more quickly for a time.

procEffects.description: When enemies Block, Parry, or Evade your attacks, you have a chance of quickly following up from another angle, dealing:

1879226918.name: Ring of Fire
1879226918.desc: Utilize the power of Fire to counter Saruman's attempts to drain this ring of its power.

1879228582.name: Drink Deep
1879228582.desc: You bite your target, drinking deeply and replenishing your health.

1879230502.name: Snap!
1879230502.desc:
A sharp snap of your jaws and your target's defence is weakened.

  On critical hit, your target's pain is so great they cannot speak but to scream for a few seconds.

   <rgb=#00FFDD>Requires a Critical Response</rgb>

1879231270.name: Fist and Shield
1879231270.desc: Mastery over the Fist: Allows Warden to perform Fist Gambits quickly.

1879241638.name: Cry of the Eorlingas
1879241638.desc: Crying to the land of Rohan, you strike your foe a powerful blow.

1879266854.name: Elweleth's Hairpin
1879266854.desc: Elweleth gave this hairpin to Radanir as a token of her affection. It is both decorative and very, very sharp.

1879305766.name: Red Chicken
1879305766.desc: Summons a red chicken to brighten your day.

1879360806.name: Gorgoroth Crawler
1879360806.desc: Brings out a Gorgoroth crawler to keep you company.

1879391398.name: Call to Arms: Herald of Hope (Elvish Swordswoman)
1879391398.desc: You enlist a Herald to carry your Banner of Hope into battle. This banner increases the mitigations of those around it.

1879411750.name: Silver Donkey
1879411750.desc: Summons a loveable and hard-working donkey.

1879415718.name: Subtle Portent of Deftness
1879415718.desc: A quick burst of defence, absorbing a portion of damage dealt to you.

1879445158.name: Guide to Tornhad
1879445158.desc: Returns you and your Fellowship to Tornhad.\n\nThis skill is easily interrupted.

1879458214.name: Fiery Blue Beetle
1879458214.desc: Summons a friendly blue beetle to accompany you on your journeys.

1879465510.name: Summer Concert Firefly
1879465510.desc: Summons a musically inspired firefly to accompany you on your journeys.

1879466278.name: Breath of Fire
1879466278.desc: Breathe spirits through the flame of a torch, setting alight any enemies with the misfortune to be standing before you.

conditionalEffects.description: Haversack skills may reduce your target's Outgoing and Incoming Damage.

1879467814.name: Hurricane
1879467814.desc: You move like a hurricane of claws and teeth, bringing nature's fury to your enemies. For a brief duration, raise your evasion to 100%, enfuriating your foes with each strike they are unable to return.

1879485990.name: Friend of Large Hunters (Savannah Stalker)
1879485990.desc: Summons a big cat companion.\n\nThe cat is capable of attacking multiple foes at once.

1879495334.name: Memory of Justice
1879495334.desc: A Memory of Justice can be used to punish creatures of evil.

1879506598.name: Sorcerous Study I
1879506598.desc: Your study of ancient malefic powers allows you to maintain a malevolent spell until the final word is spoken.\n\n<rgb=#00ffff>Prepared spells deal less initial damage.</rgb>

1879508006.name: Horn of Oromë
1879508006.desc: Blow a hunting horn with the fury and conviction of Oromë, inspiring allies and giving you courage when you need it most.

1879508646.name: Copper Scorpion
1879508646.desc: Summons a copper scorpion to accompany you on your travels.

1879516454.name: Swallow Light
1879516454.desc: Free yourself from any negative combat states and gain Venom.\n\n<rgb=#FF0000>Being slowed by a skill or effect will not allow this skill use.</rgb>

1879532454.name: Scout Herbs
1879532454.desc: You apply Scout herbs to yourself or an ally, restoring 7% of maximum Morale every 5 seconds for 25 seconds.
